captureMethod: Default screenshot API returned JPEG; no file was saved under a false PNG extension. Used supported Chrome CDP Page.captureScreenshot formatpng. Raw returned PNG bytes saved without resizing, cropping, compositing or pixel edits. PNG header widths/heights and SHA256 recorded in manifest.

reviewSummary: All17 saved nativePNGs visually reviewed once across the run and final offline pass. Exact header dimensions andSHA256 independently rechecked. The initial scrolled320baseline is supplemental layout evidence only. Map filter chips scroll horizontally; weather/count subtitles ellipsize, with fullcounts confirmed by renderedDOM. No globalhorizontaloverflow was measured.
